# VEG ER for Pets

> > VEG is a network of 24/7 emergency veterinary hospitals providing urgent pet care, exotic animal treatment, and blood bank services across the United States.

Founded by Dr. David Bessler and David Glattstein, VEG operates emergency animal hospitals with open floor plans, allowing pet owners to stay with their animals during treatment. The network includes locations across multiple states staffed by emergency veterinary specialists and offers services including emergency surgery, critical care, and a canine blood donation program.

## Key Topics

- 24-hour emergency veterinary care
- Urgent pet care and animal hospitals
- Emergency veterinary services
- Exotic animal care and treatment
- Veterinary blood bank and canine blood donation
- Open floor plan emergency rooms
- Emergency veterinary surgery
- Pet emergency medicine
- Critical care for animals
- 24/7 veterinary hospitals
- Emergency DVM careers and NERD Program
- Multi-state veterinary network
- Emergency animal treatment

- [Pennsylvania Emergency Vet Locations](https://www.veg.com/locations/pennsylvania): VEG 24/7 emergency vet locations in Pennsylvania (Philadelphia, Pittsburgh)
- [North Carolina Emergency Vet Locations](https://www.veg.com/locations/north-carolina): VEG 24/7 emergency vet locations in NC (Asheville, Cary, Charlotte)

- [New Mexico Emergency Vet Locations](https://www.veg.com/locations/new-mexico): VEG 24/7 emergency vet locations in New Mexico (Albuquerque)

- [Commack, NY Emergency Vet](https://www.veg.com/locations/new-york/commack): VEG Commack 24/7 emergency vet on Long Island, Dr. Mario Costa
